{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Final computation: print the three required values as strings with 4 decimal places
# to match the expected precision

# Load and clean data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == '999999.99'
df_clean = df_completed[~qa_mask]
df_clean['revenue'] = df_clean['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Compute conversion rates
conversion_rates = df_clean.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()

# Extract and print the three values with 4 decimal places
email_rate = conversion_rates['email']
paid_search_rate = conversion_rates['paid_search']
diff = email_rate - paid_search_rate

print(f"{email_rate:.4f}")
print(f"{paid_search_rate:.4f}")
print(f"{diff:.4f}")"}
